title: Passive fin unit-drive normalization, fixed pre-execution comparison

receiver.oracle: 100-digit Decimal direct hyperbolic ODE solution; explicitly exact matched dyadic identities; no producer helper imports
receiver.atol: 5e-13 * abs(expected) for general ODE; zero for named dyadic/null/false controls
receiver.execution: All 32 unclaimed and 70 claimed calls before one aggregate assertion; retain raw verdicts despite strict JSON failure

decisions.base: Two metric claims per system. A finite reference is a truthful numeric claim; a null reference is challenged with zero and must refuse.
decisions.additional: On tiny-positive of each main passive mode, also challenge efficiency=1 and effectiveness=0, both must refuse.

unchanged: Input guards and physical pass predicate
scope.zero_drive: Literal heat-rate ratios are undefined: null plus named status and numeric-claim refusal. No silent continuous extension.
scope.arithmetic: Exact composition of accepted binary64 analytic shape factors protects range. Square roots/exponentials remain approximate; this is not an exact physical certificate.

preservation.gates: Every maintained CI gate; no workflow edits

registered_pi.mode: Actual registered tool.execute through unchanged routing; all calls captured before assertions; dedicated unittest wrapper and pytest cases
cases: infinite G=1/2 with physical q rounding to zero
registered_pi.inherited_control: Independently driven prescribed-temperature hot tip retained

first_execution: Matched stock/candidate maintained pull-request CI only. Freeze source, receiver, protocol, README and heads before creating PRs. No local numerical runs or retuned oracle.
receipt: Preserve both complete original logs once. Verify actual CI checkout trees, row equality, source hashes and direct landed-tree equality.

primary_sources.title: Lienhard and Lienhard, A Heat Transfer Textbook, sixth edition, section4.5, equations4.31,4.52-4.54
primary_sources.interpretation: Full-surface efficiency differs from the existing lateral-only Robin metric; the preserved reference is explicit.

claim_limit: Maintained source qualification only. No new model/contest score, timing comparison or exact transcendental solution.
